name: restaurant-management-system
description: Restaurant POS Laravel API. Frontends live in restaurant-pos-website, -operations and -desktop.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,QUEUE,REVERB "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:reverb"
scripts.dev:queue: cd apps/api && php artisan queue:work redis --queue=default --sleep=1 --tries=3 --timeout=60
